notes: A roll page of the Legislative Assembly: nothing but lists of names, with no speech, no speaker label, no stenographer note and no section heading, so utterance_starts is empty and any speaker the parser finds here is a false positive. The list of present members carries over from the previous page and ends mid-page; the lower half restarts with the absent and leave-of-absence lists. As on the other roll page in my set I filed AUSENTES CON AVISO and LICENCIA as furniture rather than headings, since they label columns of the roll and not sections of a debate. This page has no running header, no page number and no footer printed on it at all — unusual for the corpus and worth knowing, since the date and page cannot be recovered from the page itself. DEFECT worth a maintainer's attention: the last line of the LICENCIA column, '*RIVAS, Jorge – no incorporado', is printed over a bright yellow highlight. It is an editing mark that was never cleared before the record was published, and it is the only coloured element on the page; I verified it at high magnification. Its leading asterisk has no matching footnote anywhere on the page.
